verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ מוֹצָ֑א לַכֶּ֣סֶף וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yêš mō·w·ṣā lak·ke·sep̄ ū·mā·qō·wm laz·zā·hāḇ yā·zōq·qū
verses.literal: Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined

verses.original: בַּ֭רְזֶל יֻקָּ֑ח מֵעָפָ֣ר נְחוּשָֽׁה׃ יָצ֥וּק וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן
verses.transliteration: bar·zel yuq·qāḥ mê·‘ā·p̄ār nə·ḥū·šāh yā·ṣūq wə·’e·ḇen
verses.literal: Iron is taken from the earth and copper is smelted from ore

verses.original: שָׂ֤ם קֵ֤ץ׀ לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר וּֽלְכָל־ תַּ֭כְלִית אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: śām qêṣ la·ḥō·šeḵ hū ḥō·w·qêr ū·lə·ḵāl- taḵ·lîṯ ’e·ḇen ’ō·p̄el wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: [Man] puts an end to the darkness he probes the farthest recesses . . . for ore in deepest darkness . . .

verses.original: מִנִּי־ מֵֽעִם־ גָּ֗ר פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל׀ הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים רָ֑גֶל מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ דַּ֖לּוּ נָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: min·nî- mê·‘im- gār pā·raṣ na·ḥal han·niš·kā·ḥîm rā·ḡel mê·’ĕ·nō·wōš dal·lū nā·‘ū
verses.literal: Far from . . . human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man Far from men he dangles and sways

verses.original: לָ֑חֶם יֵֽצֵא־ מִמֶּ֥נָּה אֶ֗רֶץ וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ־ אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḥem yê·ṣê- mim·men·nāh ’e·reṣ wə·ṯaḥ·te·hā neh·paḵ kə·mōw- ’êš
verses.literal: Food may come from the earth but from below it is transformed as by fire

verses.original: אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ מְקוֹם־ סַפִּ֥יר וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā mə·qō·wm- sap·pîr wə·‘ap̄·rōṯ zā·hāḇ lōw
verses.literal: Its rocks are the source of sapphires containing flecks of gold

verses.original: לֹֽא־ עָ֑יִט יְדָ֣עוֹ נָ֭תִיב וְלֹ֥א אַיָּֽה׃ עֵ֣ין שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ
verses.transliteration: lō- ‘ā·yiṭ yə·ḏā·‘ōw nā·ṯîḇ wə·lō ’ay·yāh ‘ên šə·zā·p̲at·tû
verses.literal: No bird of prey knows that path no falcon’s eye has seen it

verses.original: בְנֵי־ שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא־ הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ לֹֽא־ שָֽׁחַל׃ עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- šā·ḥaṣ lō- hiḏ·rî·ḵu·hū lō- šā·ḥal ‘ā·ḏāh ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Proud beasts . . . have never trodden it no lion has ever prowled over it

verses.original: שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ הָפַ֖ךְ הָרִֽים׃ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: šā·laḥ yā·ḏōw ba·ḥal·lā·mîš hā·p̄aḵ hā·rîm miš·šō·reš
verses.literal: The miner strikes . . . the flint he overturns mountains at their base

verses.original: בִּקֵּ֑עַ יְאֹרִ֣ים בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת עֵינֽוֹ׃ רָאֲתָ֥ה וְכָל־ יְ֝קָ֗ר
verses.transliteration: biq·qê·a‘ yə·’ō·rîm baṣ·ṣū·rō·wṯ ‘ê·nōw rā·’ă·ṯāh wə·ḵāl yə·qār
verses.literal: He hews out channels in the rocks and his eyes spot every treasure

verses.original: חִבֵּ֑שׁ מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת יֹ֣צִא וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ אֽוֹר׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥib·bêš mib·bə·ḵî nə·hā·rō·wṯ yō·ṣi wə·ṯa·ʿă·lu·må̄h ’ō·wr
verses.literal: He stops up the sources of the streams to bring what is hidden to light

verses.original: מֵאַ֣יִן וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י בִּינָֽה׃ זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·yin wə·ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh tim·mā·ṣê wə·’ê bî·nāh zeh mə·qō·wm
verses.literal: But where can wisdom be found and where does understanding . . . dwell

verses.original: לֹא־ אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָדַ֣ע עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ĕ·nō·wōš yā·ḏa‘ ‘er·kāh wə·lō ṯim·mā·ṣê bə·’e·reṣ ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: No man can know its value nor is it found in the land of the living

verses.original: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר הִ֑יא לֹ֣א בִי־ וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·hō·wm ’ā·mar hî lō ḇî- wə·yām ’ā·mar ’ên ‘im·mā·ḏî
verses.literal: The ocean depths say It [is] not in me while the sea declares [It is] not with me

verses.original: לֹא־ יֻתַּ֣ן תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ סְג֣וֹר וְלֹ֥א מְחִירָֽהּ׃ יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף
verses.transliteration: lō- yut·tan taḥ·te·hā sə·ḡō·wr wə·lō mə·ḥî·rāh yiš·šā·qêl ke·sep̄
verses.literal: It cannot be bought with gold nor [can] its price be weighed out in silver

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר יָקָ֣ר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם וְסַפִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯə·sul·leh bə·ḵe·ṯem ’ō·w·p̄îr yā·qār bə·šō·ham wə·sap·pîr
verses.literal: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir in precious onyx or sapphire

verses.original: לֹא־ זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה כְּלִי־ פָֽז׃ וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ
verses.transliteration: lō- zā·hāḇ ū·zə·ḵō·w·ḵîṯ ya·‘ar·ḵen·nāh kə·lî- p̄āz ū·ṯə·mū·rā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: rā·mō·wṯ wə·ḡā·ḇîš lō yiz·zā·ḵêr ū·me·šeḵ ḥāḵ·māh mip·pə·nî·nîm
verses.literal: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention the price of wisdom [is] beyond rubies

verses.original: פִּטְדַת־ כּ֑וּשׁ לֹֽא־ יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה׃פ טָ֝ה֗וֹר בְּכֶ֥תֶם
verses.transliteration: piṭ·ḏaṯ- kūš lō- ya·‘ar·ḵen·nāh lō ṯə·sul·leh ṭā·hō·wr bə·ḵe·ṯem
verses.literal: Topaz from Cush cannot compare to it nor can it be valued in pure gold

verses.original: מֵאַ֣יִן וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה בִּינָֽה׃ מְק֣וֹם
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·yin wə·ha·ḥā·ḵə·māh tā·ḇō·w wə·’ê zeh bî·nāh mə·qō·wm
verses.literal: From where then, does wisdom come and where . . . does understanding dwell

verses.original: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ חָ֑י נִסְתָּֽרָה׃ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם
verses.transliteration: wə·ne·‘el·māh mê·‘ê·nê ḵāl ḥāy nis·tā·rāh ū·mê·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the air

verses.original: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ׃ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇad·dō·wn wā·mā·weṯ ’ā·mə·rū šā·ma‘·nū šim·‘āh bə·’ā·zə·nê·nū
verses.literal: Abaddon and Death say We have heard a rumor about it -

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת־ מְקוֹמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm hê·ḇîn dar·kāh wə·hū yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- mə·qō·w·māh
verses.literal: But God understands its way and He knows - its place

verses.original: כִּי־ ה֭וּא יַבִּ֑יט לִקְצוֹת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ יִרְאֶֽה׃ כָּל־ תַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם
verses.transliteration: kî- hū yab·bîṭ liq·ṣō·wṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ yir·’eh kāl- ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·ma·yim
verses.literal: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁקָ֑ל לָר֣וּחַ תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה׃ וּ֝מַ֗יִם
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miš·qāl lā·rū·aḥ tik·kên bə·mid·dāh ū·ma·yim
verses.literal: When God fixed the weight of the wind vvv and measured out the waters

verses.original: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ חֹ֑ק לַמָּטָ֣ר וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ʿă·śō·ṯō ḥōq lam·mā·ṭār wə·ḏe·reḵ la·ḥă·zîz qō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: when He set a limit for the rain and a path for the thunderbolt . . .

verses.original: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם־ חֲקָרָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz rā·’āh way·sap·pə·rāh hĕ·ḵî·nāh wə·ḡam- ḥă·qā·rāh
verses.literal: then He looked at [wisdom] and appraised it He established it . . . and searched it out

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר׀ לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·’ā·ḏām hên yir·’aṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy hî ḥāḵ·māh wə·sūr mê·rā‘ bî·nāh
verses.literal: And He said to man Behold the fear of the Lord that [is] wisdom and to turn away from evil [is] understanding
